correctness.rationale: Each of the n affine charts is exactly k+m^2 by monomial degree 2 and 3 generation for d>=5; their polynomial normalizations are finite birational and glue. The conductor is m^2 and the quotient has r linear monomial classes, providing a full exact sheaf sequence. Local cohomology shows depth1, m^2/m^4 gives embedding dimension, and the exact Hilbert--Samuel function gives multiplicity 2^r. Projection formula, Euler characteristic and pullback of O(1) prove all global invariants. Independent finite enumerations were run for five n,d cases with cutoff9; finite checks not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Actual monomial-generator and tangent-projection comparisons found no dominating theorem. The strongest multi-pinch theorem inspected, Maddox--Pandey Section 5, explicitly assumes all removed vectors have coordinate maximum below d-1, so it does not include our removed vectors of coordinate maximum d-1. Caviglia single-pinch and Caviglia--Conca one-center cubic projection have different objects. Previously published Togliatti and other projected-Veronese examples have different defining monomial systems and do not imply the conductor-and-cohomology statement. Residual risk of equivalent toric literature is reported.
residual_risks: Monomial toric projections from simultaneous tangent coordinate directions could have been described in an unidentified paper under different terminology.
No independent specialist validation or exhaustive bibliographic search has been performed.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical simultaneous suppression of all tangent directions at the coordinate points of a Veronese embedding. Uniform exact conductor and local ring identify what degeneration this symmetric projective projection creates, while its n(n-1) global defect, depth and H^1 quantify intrinsic nonnormality; these are motivated structural local-to-global invariants not determined by one-pinch Koszulness.
